About the Studio

A slower room, in a fast city

Remi began with a simple frustration: making art had become something people watched other people do online. So we opened a studio where the paint is real, the clay is cold and heavy, and nobody apologises for being a beginner.

Our philosophy is that creativity is not a talent you are born with — it is a practice you make space for. Every workshop is kept deliberately small, every material is prepared before you arrive, and every session ends with something you made, in your hands.

“You arrive curious. You leave with paint on your sleeve and a piece of work that is entirely, unmistakably yours.”
Small by designNever more than twelve people in a room, so teaching stays personal.
Materials includedProfessional-grade paints, clay, paper and tools — nothing to bring.
Beginners firstMost guests have not picked up a brush since school. That is the point.
Time to breatheTea, music and unhurried sessions. The studio runs on studio time.

Good to Know

Questions, answered

How do I book and pay?

Choose a workshop, pick a date and time, tell us how many places you need, add your details and pay on this page. You will see a confirmation straight away. In this concept preview the payment step is a demonstration — no real payment is taken.

What is your cancellation and refund policy?

Sample policy for demonstration: full refund up to 7 days before your workshop, a studio credit up to 48 hours before, and transfers to another date are free once. Final policy to be confirmed by the studio.

Are materials and equipment included?

Yes. Every workshop price includes all materials, tools, an apron and firing or finishing where relevant — pottery pieces are glazed and fired for collection a few weeks later. Just bring yourself.

I have never made art before. Can I come?

Absolutely — most of our guests are complete beginners. Sessions are taught step by step in small groups, and teachers circulate throughout so nobody is left staring at a blank canvas.

How long do workshops last?

Most sessions run between two and three hours, including a short break. The exact duration is shown on every workshop card and detail page before you book.

Can I book for a group or a private event?

Yes — you can book up to the full session capacity of twelve places online. For private hire, team socials and celebrations, use the contact form below and we will plan something around your group. Group terms to be confirmed.
